C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235.IntentSummary: Deliver one governed vertical repair for document runtime readiness, Docomator diagnostics and Unicode-safe upload transport, with strict target activation, preserved provenance, responsive inline errors and release-grade regression evidence.

MustContain.Text: Полный bundle не может быть активирован

MustPassCommand.Command: node --test tests/http-headers.test.mjs tests/http-utils.test.mjs tests/docomator-integration.test.mjs tests/offline-package-policy.test.mjs tests/deploy-install-contract.test.mjs tests/deployment-flow.test.mjs

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: fix the install, repair, upload and integration state model

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The full-profile path has explicit preflight, package preparation, smoke, activation, repair and rollback states; no state is named ready while OCR is blocked.
Unicode upload normalization is invisible to the operator and preserves the source name, while Docomator errors retain entered connection context and offer one clear correction.
Partial Docomator failure never blocks local structure management and package failure never damages the previously active release.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: specify stable inline diagnostics for desktop and mobile

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Protocol, host, port, access code, check action, endpoint and status remain in a stable card; failures use an inline status and no modal.
Desktop and mobile preserve focus, readable wrapping and tap targets; access code and dangerous transport state are never-learn controls.
No visual control is added for transport hashing because the user should only observe a successful upload.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: apply no-motion to failures and transport normalization

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Error appearance, upload header normalization and full-install rejection use no-motion; meaning never depends on animation.
Existing busy-state feedback may use a restrained short transition, and prefers-reduced-motion removes all nonessential transitions.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve source identity and define immutable package-cache authority

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No schema change is required; Unicode source names, bytes, hashes, document versions and evidence remain authoritative and unchanged.
The cache identity derives from verified target profile and manifest digest, is copied atomically and is safe to reuse after interruption.
Repeated repair and repeated request canonicalization are deterministic and idempotent.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement strict full activation, safe Docomator errors and Unicode headers

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The installer caches and verifies the target payload, installs missing packages, runs real smoke checks and refuses the full release before staging when any required document capability remains unavailable.
Repair discovers the retained payload and runs before strict acceptance; unknown server failures remain private while classified Docomator failures remain actionable.
One imported browser helper normalizes raw idempotency values before native Headers construction and fetch, without changing callers or source metadata.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently inspect implemented errors, focus and responsive stability

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The audit records pass or actionable findings for actual desktop, mobile, keyboard and reduced-motion behavior and verifies that the implementation matches design.md and motion.md.
No blocker or major finding remains unresolved before tests are declared final.

T-007.Title: kafedra-tests: cover Unicode, classified gateway failures and strict package recovery

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit and integration tests cover synchronous UTF-8 SHA-256, canonical stability, Header shapes, safe error serialization, network categories, wrong service and not-ready responses.
Playwright verifies desktop and mobile inline failure and Unicode request construction; deployment tests verify strict full activation and retained repair payload contracts.
Focused tests and the complete project test suite pass without mocks in production code.

T-008.Title: kafedra-release: prove exact-target offline install, rollback and exact-head CI

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The Debian full bundle and systemd target test complete with strict OCR, Poppler and LibreOffice acceptance; no degraded full install is accepted.
Backup, update, repeated install, interruption recovery and rollback remain green, and documentation states that Astra requires its own matching reference build.
GRACE final and every required exact-head project check are green before squash merge; post-merge checks precede a separate archive-only applied transition.
